title: Assign a tenant by tapping a bed, from the bed grid and from All rooms
description: Product Owner request: tapping a bed should offer two choices - view details, or assign a tenant - so onboarding can start from the bed the warden is looking at, rather than only from the Tenants tab. Should work from the bed grid inside a floor and from the All rooms tiles. WHY THIS MATTERS: today onboarding runs Tenants > + > Pick a Vacant Bed, which asks the warden to find the bed in a list after they have already been looking straight at it in Property. The bed picker (BedPickerScreen) stays as the entry point from the Tenants tab; this adds the reverse direction. CURRENT STATE: beds on BedGridScreen are not clickable at all - the tiles render status but have no onClick, so there is nothing to extend and the interaction has to be added. From All rooms a tile opens the room's bed grid, so the bed-level action can live in one place if the grid is the target for both. RESOLVED BY THE PO: an OCCUPIED bed does not show the two-option sheet at all - it goes straight to the assigned tenant's profile, which is already where every operation on that tenancy lives (notes, notice, transfer, credit, checkout). So the sheet is a vacant-bed interaction, and an occupied bed is a single tap through to the person in it. That is better than a sheet with a disabled option: it removes a decision instead of showing the warden something they cannot use. OPEN QUESTIONS still for the PO: (1) what 'view description' shows for a VACANT bed, where there is no tenancy - probably the room's own details (type, price per bed, amenities), since the bed itself has only a label and a status. If that is all it is, consider whether the option earns its place or whether a vacant bed should simply assign. (2) Whether assign from here skips the bed-picker step and jumps straight to the tenant form with the bed pre-selected, which is the whole point of the shortcut.
acceptanceCriteria: Beds are tappable on BedGridScreen, which they are not today
Tapping a VACANT bed presents the two choices rather than acting immediately - view details, or assign a tenant
Assign leads into the existing onboarding flow with that bed already chosen, so the warden is not asked to pick it again
The same interaction is reachable for a bed arrived at via All rooms, so both routes behave identically
Tapping an OCCUPIED bed goes straight to the assigned tenant's profile, with no intermediate sheet, so every operation on that tenancy is one tap away
A bed can never be assigned twice - the assign path is unreachable for an occupied bed, so no second tenancy can be created on one bed
A bed whose tenancy is somehow missing does not dead-end or crash - it falls back to the vacant behaviour rather than navigating to a profile that is not there
The existing Tenants tab onboarding route via BedPickerScreen keeps working unchanged

history.note: Filed at the Product Owner's request: assign a tenant by tapping a bed, from the bed grid and from All rooms. PO clarified mid-filing that an occupied bed should go straight to the assigned tenant's profile rather than showing a sheet - folded in, so the two-option sheet is a vacant-bed interaction only.
